answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 15608 Country: India Title: I have anus oosing problem which spoil clothes once any timein 24 hrs. Can I observe fast during the comming? Question: I have anus oosing problem which spoil clothes once any timein 24 hrs. Can I observe fast during the comming? Answer ID: 15608 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1887/1515=H=1430) This disease will not prevent you from fasting. If it oozes while you are fasting, the sawm (fast) will not be invalidated. However, you should observe the fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
